title: The Upstream Town Where Error Went Another Way

features.name: message-board-rewriting
features.desc-on-touch: The signs here change their conclusions nightly, learning backwards from the errors downstream. You're watching a town that decided to contradict itself.

features.name: misaligned-settlement
features.desc-on-touch: The houses don't quite meet each other—built by people who couldn't agree on which direction north was pointing. Every building is slightly rotated wrong.

features.name: forks-that-branch-wrong
features.desc-on-touch: Every intersection here offers three directions when there should be four. The paths disagree on how many choices are real.

features.name: the-water-tank-of-unmade-memory
features.desc-on-touch: It recalls rainfall from towns upstream that turned out not to exist—memory written by someone else's error. The tank is a mirror, but not for this town.

features.name: chorus-of-contradicting-names
features.desc-on-touch: Three different maps are filed here side by side. Each names this place differently. The archive has stopped deciding which one is right.

inscription: error arrived here and learned to dissolve instead of settle

file.name: Three_Histories_Same_Town_One_Disagreement.txt
file.note: The archive stored three local histories that contradict each other fundamentally. It chose to keep all three instead of deciding.

exits.label: back toward the town where opinion hardened
upriver where the first mistakes were still soft
into the green field that hasn't chosen sides
